subject: CloudSummit stage: content packet, demo script, and logistics
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@cloudsummit.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudSummit Partnerships <partners@cloudsummit.co>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor logistics: 10-min showcase + one-pager request

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for signing on as a sponsor for CloudSummit North America. We're finalizing the session schedule and need a short content packet from each showcase sponsor by next Monday so our content team can build the app/website and pass materials to the AV crew. Specifically we need: 

- A one-page PDF overview for the sponsor directory (logo + 3 bullets)
- A 10-minute demo script / run-of-show (speaker + live demo notes)
- One slide of metrics or a customer highlight (optional)

Can you send these by 10 May? Also attaching the sponsor guide with AV deadlines and shipping notes.

(attachment: CloudSummit_Sponsor_Guide.pdf)

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Partnerships Manager
CloudSummit

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@cloudsummit.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor logistics: 10-min showcase + one-pager request

Samantha,

Thanks — we can do that. I've put together a first pass and am looping in content and events folks for quick review. Plan:

- Deliverables by 10 May: one-pager (PDF), demo script (Markdown), single metric slide (PDF)
- Tell me the preferred image ratio for the one-pager (logo placement) and any logo/brand requirements
- AV ask: will there be a 2nd laptop on stage or should we plan for a single laptop + remote?

Dropping the drafts now for internal review: (attachments: CS_demo_script_v1.md, onepager-draft.pdf)

Marissa / Sean / Rishi — quick asks:
- Marissa: swap the case study call-out to the AcmeCorp pilot (I think it resonates with the audience)
- Sean: add a 60s fallback video + runbook notes for the live demo failover
- Rishi: any compliance or data-retention language we should call out for the one-pager?

I can consolidate and send to Samantha once we have edits.

Thanks,
Mina
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor logistics: 10-min showcase + one-pager request

On Mon, May 3, 2027 at 10:37 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Dropping the drafts now for internal review: (attachments: CS_demo_script_v1.md, onepager-draft.pdf)

Looks good — quick notes inline:

- One-pager: tighten headline to "LLM inference for production-grade apps" and move logo to top-left. Swap customer highlight to AcmeCorp (see attached summary).
- Demo script: move the interactive Q&A to the final 60s, shorten the opening to 60s. Add a callout for the runtime fallbacks.

Attachment: acme_study_summary.docx (short summary + 2 metrics)

I can polish the one-pager copy; please keep the design simple for print.

—Marissa

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor logistics: 10-min showcase + one-pager request

Quick operational add: for a 10-minute live demo I strongly recommend a 2-device setup (presenter's laptop + backup laptop) and a recorded 60s demo video as a fallback in case of network/model latency. I put a lightweight runbook in the folder.

Highlights for runbook (attachment: runbook-playback.txt):
- Cue times (0:00 welcome, 1:00 problem, 3:00 live demo start, 8:30 wrap/Q&A)
- Fallback: if model call exceeds 8s, switch to pre-recorded video and continue Q&A
- AV contact template: please add stage contact name

I'll help with AV on-site; ping me when you have times.

—Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@cloudsummit.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final sponsor packet and AV questions — CloudSummit slot #B4 (10 May deadline)

Samantha — attaching the finalized materials for the CloudSummit sponsor directory and stage. Thanks for the deadline reminder.

Deliverables attached:
- onepager-final.pdf (formatted for print, 8.5x11)
- CS_demo_script_v2.md (10-min script with cue times)
- metric_slide.pdf (single slide with AcmeCorp highlight)
- runbook-playback.txt (live demo fallback steps)

Questions for logistics team:
1) AV: will you provide a secondary stage laptop or should we ship one?
2) Stage input: HDMI + USB-C available? Do you prefer we bring our own dongles?
3) Arrival window and check-in procedure for sponsors (we assume 90 minutes)

(attachments: onepager-final.pdf, CS_demo_script_v2.md, metric_slide.pdf, runbook-playback.txt)

If you confirm AV and arrival timing I will upload the final assets to your Drive link and send speaker bios.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@cloudsummit.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudSummit Partnerships <partners@cloudsummit.co>, AcmeCorp Events <events@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final sponsor packet and AV questions — CloudSummit slot #B4 (10 May deadline)

Mina — perfect, thanks for the quick turn. Confirming:

- AV: we provide HDMI + USB-C and stage laptop on request. Please let us know by EOD if you want us to reserve a stage machine (we can image it with a test profile).
- Arrival: sponsors check in at 10:00 local on the day of the event (we recommend 90 mins earlier for soundcheck).
- Shipping: ship materials to the Convention Center (address in the sponsor guide) with "Exhibitor Booth B4" and include return label.

Also sending an exhibitor agreement via DocuSign now for signatures (attachment: exhibitor_agreement_docusign.pdf).

See you on stage — I'll add Sean to the AV sync thread.

Best,
Samantha
Partnerships Manager
CloudSummit
